decisions.reason: As an agency-focused compliance add-on that remained on its own page into 2024, it fits the firm's compliance push and is inexpensive enough to keep as an option while demand becomes clearer.
Because the web hosting management platform stayed prominent on the home page across 2023 and 2024 and directly extends the core hosting business, the evidence supports continued commitment.

The configurable managed hosting plan is a close extension of the established offer, continued to be marketed in 2024, and likely has low incremental cost on existing infrastructure, so the option should be kept open.

Extended PHP security support was only launched in 2024, strongly matches the firm's security and compliance positioning, and should be retained because uncertainty is still high and carrying costs are likely modest.
